title: The First Focus Flame
description: Caiden notices his attention pulling in three directions and learns how to choose the first brave step.

comicPanels.alt: A cave scene from Caiden's Courage
comicPanels.narration: The Courage world opens with a small glow, a busy day, and Caiden wondering where to begin.

comicPanels.alt: A glowing path scene from Caiden's Courage
comicPanels.narration: Every adventure starts the same way: pause, look around, and find the next right thing.

dialogue.text: My brain has a lot of tabs open. Maybe the brave move is picking one tab first.
Focus Flame check: what matters first, what can wait, and what helps you start?

options: Do everything at the same time
Ask for one clear next step

title: Signal in the Noise
description: The day gets louder, and Caiden practices telling the difference between a focus clue and a distraction.

comicPanels.alt: A dark courage scene from Caiden's Courage
comicPanels.narration: A new scene brings new choices. Some sparkle because they matter, and some sparkle because they are loud.

dialogue.text: I can feel my focus drifting. I need a way to spot the real mission.
Look for the clue that helps the goal. That is your signal.

options: The one connected to the goal

title: The Time Trail
description: Caiden follows the trail from now to later and learns how time choices shape the adventure.

comicPanels.narration: The next path is not only about courage. It is about knowing when each step belongs.

dialogue.text: If I know what comes now and what comes later, the whole trail feels less huge.
That is planning power. Put the next step where you can see it.

choice.prompt: How should Caiden handle the time trail?
options: Save every step for the end
